stemMarkdown: Two runners start at the same time from the same point on a circular track of length 300 m and run in opposite directions at 6 m/s and 17 m/s. After how many seconds will they first meet? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Running in opposite directions, relative speed $= 6 + 17 = 23$ m/s. They first meet after covering the full circumference between them: time $= \dfrac{300}{23} = 13.04$ s.
